segments.text: As he chewed, his eyes drifted toward the crackling fireplace.

segments.speaker: pip
segments.text: Though... now that I reflect upon the winter season... gingerbread has always been the superior festive biscuit. A touch of molasses, a bite of clove...

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: FLASH!

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: Right inside Pip’s mouth, a tiny puff of golden cinnamon sparkles puffed out of his nostrils!

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: Pip’s jaw froze mid-chew. His ears shot straight up like two radio antennas.

segments.speaker: pip
segments.text: WHA—?!

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: Pip gasped, his eyes bulging.

segments.speaker: pip
segments.text: MY CHOCOLATE CHIP JUST WENT CLOVE! IT'S WARM! IT'S SPICY! IT TURNED INTO GINGERBREAD IN THE MIDDLE OF MY TEETH! MADAME, YOUR BAKING IS DEFYING THE LAWS OF THERMODYNAMICS!

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: Granny winked at you.

segments.speaker: pip
segments.text: Go on, sweetheart. Try yours.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: You pick up a warm, sugar-dusted cookie. As you lift it to your mouth, you're still thinking about Pip's gingerbread.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: You take a bite—and the rich, sweet warmth of ginger and molasses explodes across your tongue, crunchy on the edges and soft in the middle.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: Wow, you think, savoring the flavor. This would be amazing with a mug of hot chocolate.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: POOF.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: Instantly, the center of the cookie turns into a warm, creamy, velvety pocket of rich melted marshmallow and molten hot cocoa, coating your mouth in sweet, silky chocolate!

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: You laugh out loud, your eyes wide with pure wonder.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: It really is magic!

c5p6.title: The Bravest Dog in Everfrost & The Choice

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: With the feast finished, the clock on the wall gave a heavy tick: TICK-TOCK.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: The velvet carrying case containing the Forward Escapement Gear rested by the door. It was time to go.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: Granny walked over to Titan, who was sitting politely on his haunches, his big brown eyes filled with deep, soulful gratitude.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: From her apron pocket, Granny pulled out a special, hand-stitched burlap pouch tied with a bright red velvet ribbon. Inside were five massive, bone-shaped cookies that smelled like sweet smoke, bacon, and golden honey.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: She reached out with both hands and gave Titan the most glorious, double-handed scratch right behind his black-freckled ears.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: Titan closed his eyes in pure bulldog heaven, letting out a deep, rumble-snore of utter contentment.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: These are for you, sweet boy,

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: Granny whispered into his ear.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: Whenever you feel frightened... whenever the dark seems too big or the noise seems too loud... you eat one of these Courage Nubbies. And you remember that you are the bravest, strongest, most wonderful dog in the world.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: Titan took the ribbon gently between his massive jowls. He held the bag as if it were made of spun glass, his little docked tail buzzing with quiet, fierce loyalty.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: Barnaby picked up his heavy iron pipe wrench and patted his braided beard.

segments.speaker: pip
segments.text: The Grand Clock sits in the center of the village plaza,

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: Barnaby said, his voice turning serious.

segments.speaker: pip
segments.text: The lower gates are locked down tight by the Nutcracker guard battalions. But Titan's peppermint balloon can hover right over the high spires when the time comes.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: You pick up the velvet case containing the Master Cog.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: How does the team approach the Grand Clock Tower?

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: The heat and thunder inside the Grand Clock was deafening.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: You and Barnaby scrambled onto the high glass platform directly in front of the Great Pendulum. Above your head, the massive, backwards-spinning spiral of black iron groaned as it forced time in reverse.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: The housing is right there!

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: Barnaby yelled, pointing his heavy wrench at the center shaft.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: Unlatch the black spiral! Quick, before the clock strikes ten!

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: You reach into the velvet case, pulling out Barnaby's glowing star-silver Forward Cog.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: CLANG!

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: A heavy iron cage dropped from the ceiling rafters with a violent crash, slamming over Barnaby and pinning him to the floor!

segments.speaker: hero
segments.text: BARNABY!

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: you scream.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: From the shadows behind the pendulum stepped the Clockmaker, his dark velvet coat swirling with constellations of silver clock hands. In his brass-tipped fingers, he held the remote iron winch.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: A pathetic effort, my old apprentice,

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: the Clockmaker sneered, his cold gray eyes glaring through the cage bars at Barnaby.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: You will spend the rest of your immortal days locked in this iron cage, forced to oil the very gears that will keep Everfrost frozen in Christmas forever!

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: Run!

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: Barnaby roared, rattling the iron bars with his fists.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: Run, child! Save tomorrow!

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: You clutch the heavy silver cog against your chest and sprint across the narrow catwalk toward the pendulum housing. You're five feet away. Three feet away.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: You reach out to slam the cog into the gears—

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: SNAP!

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: The Clockmaker appeared at the end of the catwalk, his black obsidian pocket-watch glowing with blinding, violent purple lightning.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: You will not touch my machine, Unbound,

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: the Clockmaker hissed.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: If time will not erase you... I will erase you from the story myself!

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: The Clockmaker thrust his obsidian watch forward.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: A roaring, crackling beam of purple temporal disintegration shot across the catwalk straight toward your chest! The beam was so cold it froze the air solid, crackling with raw, erasing power.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: You can't move. You can't dodge. The beam is inches from your eyes.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: Suddenly, a blur of red wool and green tweed tackled you from the side!

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: OOF!

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: You crash violently onto the steel grating, out of the beam's deadly path.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: The purple lightning struck Pip directly in the chest.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: CRACK-BOOOOOOOM!

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: A blinding shockwave of violet light tore through the chamber.

segments.speaker: hero
segments.text: PIP!

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: you scream, scrambling on your hands and knees toward him.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: Pip was lying on the iron catwalk. The purple magic didn't hurt him—it was doing something far worse. His body was slowly turning translucent, dissolving into shimmering swirls of silver and lavender snowflakes.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: The velvet carrying case slipped from your hands, and the silver Forward Cog skittered across the metal floorboards, stopping right against the Clockmaker's boots.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: You slide to Pip’s side and reach out, but your gloved fingers pass right through his shoulder.

segments.speaker: pip
segments.text: Pip... no! Pip, hold on!

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: Tears burn in your eyes.

segments.speaker: pip
segments.text: Don't go!

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: Pip looked up at you.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: His exaggerated, silly British accent was completely gone. His yellow eyes were clear, soft, and filled with a fierce, quiet love that broke your heart.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: With trembling, fading paws, he weakly reached up toward your face.

segments.speaker: pip
segments.text: Listen to me, recruit...

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: Pip whispered, his voice faint like a fading winter echo.

segments.speaker: pip
segments.text: I'm not... I'm not really a master detective. I never was. I was just... a lonely little fox who wanted to be someone important.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: A single tear rolled through the fur on Pip's cheek.

segments.speaker: pip
segments.text: But you... you made me feel like a hero. You're the Unbound. I believe in you... I know you can fix the clock.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: Pip’s body faded into shimmering light, up to his chest, up to his whiskers.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: He smiled a soft, peaceful, unpretentious smile.

segments.speaker: pip
segments.text: Thank you...

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: Pip whispered into the freezing air,

segments.speaker: pip
segments.text: ...for being my friend.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: POOF.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: With a gentle burst of golden sparks, Pip vanished completely.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: Only his crooked houndstooth detective cap and his tattered little notebook clattered onto the cold iron floor.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: Silence filled the cavernous chamber. Only the slow, backwards ticking of the Great Clock echoed through the dark:

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: TICK... TOCK... TICK...

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: You pick up Pip’s crooked tweed hat, clutching it against your chest as tears stream down your cheeks.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: Heavy wooden boots stomped onto the catwalk. Two nine-foot Clockwork Praetorians seized you by the arms, twisting your hands behind your back and forcing you to your knees.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: The Clockmaker bent down, picked up Barnaby's forged silver cog with his brass-tipped fingers, and examined it with a cruel, mocking smile.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: Such exquisite craftsmanship,

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: the Clockmaker murmured.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: A pity it will never turn.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: The Clockmaker walked slowly toward you, standing over you on the catwalk. He looked down with cold, venomous triumph.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: Look at you, Unbound,

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: the Clockmaker sneered, his voice booming through the cathedral of gears.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: Captured. Defeated. Alone. Your little fox is erased from existence. Your master-smith is locked in an iron cage. You have NO ONE left to help you!

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: He leaned in close, his silver hair glinting in the dark.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: You will never touch the Great Clock. You will never stop the reverse countdown. And you will never see your friends or your world ever again.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: He raised his obsidian pocket-watch, preparing to lock you in chains forever.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: And that's when you hear it.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: ROOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOAR!

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: It didn't sound like a dog. It sounded like an avalanche of thunder ripping through the heavens!

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: The entire five-hundred-foot tower shuddered to its very foundation! Dust and icicles rained down from the iron rafters!

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: The Clockmaker froze mid-sentence, his eyes darting upward in utter shock.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: What in St. Nick's name is that?!

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: CRRRRRRRRR-AAAAAASH!

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: The massive stained-glass skylight four hundred feet above the clock tower shattered into a million glittering shards of colored glass!

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: Falling straight out of the snowy night sky, surrounded by swirling clouds of red-and-white peppermint canvas and roaring propane flame, was a shadow.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: A colossal, white, muscular shadow.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: BOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOM!

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: The creature landed in the center of the iron platform with an earth-shattering crash that bent the steel girders and sent the Clockwork Praetorians staggering!

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: It was Titan.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: Except... Titan didn't look like a normal bulldog anymore.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: He was standing on all four massive, tree-trunk paws. He was already the size of a grizzly bear—easily ten feet tall at the shoulders, his white coat gleaming like fresh glacier ice, his black freckles standing out like war paint!

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: Clutched in his giant front paw was Granny's hand-stitched burlap pouch.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: Titan looked at the soldiers holding you. He looked at Pip's empty hat lying on the grating.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: A low, deep, volcanic growl rumbled in Titan's massive chest, so powerful it rattled your teeth inside your skull.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: Without breaking eye contact with the Clockmaker, the giant bulldog reached into the pouch, pulled out another of Granny's Courage Nubbies, and popped it into his mouth.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: CHOMP.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: You swear, right before your very eyes...

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: HE GOT BIGGER.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: His muscular shoulders swelled to the size of steam engines! His broad chest expanded until he stood twenty feet tall, his little docked nub tail buzzing with fierce, unstoppable protective fury!

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: The Clockmaker backed away, his obsidian watch trembling in his hand.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: W-What is that thing?!

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: the Clockmaker stammered in horror.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: Titan looked down at the Clockmaker with glowing, fearless brown eyes. When he spoke, his voice was a thunderous, room-shaking roar that shook the very gears of the universe:

segments.speaker: titan
segments.text: I AM TITAN. AND NOBODY TOUCHES MY FRIEND.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: The five-hundred-foot clock tower trembled under Titan’s colossal weight.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: Standing twenty feet tall, his massive white shoulders glowing with raw Courage-Nubbie power, Titan lowered his square, black-freckled snout right down to the catwalk. His nostrils flared like two steam vents:

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: SNIIIIIIIIFFFF.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: Titan’s big brown eyes lit up with ecstatic recognition.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: He stared down at the six elite Clockwork Praetorians, who were frozen mid-stride, their wooden knees knocking together: clatter-clatter-clatter.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: Titan let out a thunderous, joyful bellow that shook the icicles from the rafters:

segments.speaker: titan
segments.text: I SMELL CHEWY WOOD!

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: RETREAT!

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: the lead Praetorian clicked in screeching, wooden terror.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: THE CANINE MEGATHERIUM DESIRES FIBER CONSUMPTION!

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: SMASH!

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: Titan swiped a colossal front paw like a snowplow!

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: Three Praetorian guards went flying through the air like wooden bowling pins, smashing into kindling against the iron girders!

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: With his other paw, Titan casually backhanded Barnaby’s iron cage.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: CRUNCH!

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: The four-inch iron bars snapped like dry pretzels. Barnaby tumbled out onto the platform, gripping his pipe wrench with a roar:

segments.speaker: pip
segments.text: THAT'S MY BOY!

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: The Clockmaker lunged forward, trying to grab his obsidian pocket-watch off the floor, but Titan planted his massive front paw right on the Clockmaker's velvet coattails, pinning him flat to the metal grating!

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: THUD.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: The silver Forward Escapement Gear flew from the Clockmaker’s grip, spinning across the glass floor and landing right at your feet.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: Titan looked down at you, his little docked nub tail wagging so hard it created a gentle breeze on the catwalk.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: GEAR SECURED, LITTLE FRIEND!

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: Titan rumbled warmly, gently scooping the last three Praetorians into his mouth like pretzel sticks: CRUNCH-CRUNCH-SNAP!

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: NOW GO FIX THAT CLOCK!

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: You scoop up Barnaby's forged star-silver cog.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: The Great Pendulum was swinging in wild, erratic arcs just ten feet in front of you. Purple temporal lightning crackled across the primary escapement.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: High above the platform, the giant bronze clock face shuddered. The massive hour hand jerked backward toward the final zero mark.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: BONG.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: One.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: Less than sixty seconds!

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: Barnaby yelled, scrambling to his feet.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: Once it strikes zero, the magic locks! You have to disengage the black reverse-spiral!

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: You leap onto the vibrating central balance platform.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: In the center of the housing sits the Clockmaker's cursed mechanism: a jagged spiral of black iron locked tight with three heavy brass alignment pins.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: Your mind hums with that quiet, extraordinary clarity. You are the Unbound.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: Where anyone else would see a terrifying maze of spinning blades and crushing gears, your brain instantly sees the hidden rhythm—the subtle pause between ticks, the exact tension of the springs, the way the pieces breathe together.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: To remove the black spiral and lock the silver Forward Cog into place, which sequence do you execute?

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: You don't fight the machinery. You listen to it.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: You wait for the Great Pendulum to reach the absolute apex of its swing—that tiny fraction of a second where time holds its breath.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: CLICK.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: You reach in with both hands, grasp the center balance pin, and twist!

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: The black iron reverse-spiral snaps free!

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: You heave the dark, jagged metal out of the housing, hurling it down into the dark abyss of the tower!

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: Before the pendulum can drop, you lift Barnaby's star-silver Forward Cog into the empty slot.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: Its golden runes flare with blinding, warm light. You slide the cog onto the drive-shaft. The silver teeth mesh with the Great Wheel in a flawless, silky glide:

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: CLIIIICK-CHUNKKKKK.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: The Unbound spark inside your mind surges through your fingertips into the metal.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: For three seconds... absolute, dead silence.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: The Great Pendulum stops dead in the center.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: The purple temporal lightning crackles... flickers... and shatters into a billion glittering golden dust motes!

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: TICK.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: The star-silver gear turns.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: TOCK.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: The Great Pendulum swings FORWARD.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: BOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOONG!

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: A glorious, resonant, golden chime explodes from the tower bells, so sweet and triumphant it vibrates in your very bones!

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: Blinding, radiant golden sunlight—the light of a million restored tomorrows—bursts from the Great Clock!

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: The golden wave washes outward from the spire, sweeping across the dark rooftops of Everfrost. In an instant, every frosted cottage window blazes with warm amber light! The frozen canals glow with crystal warmth! The aurora sky clears into a brilliant, sparkling holiday twilight!

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: And far away, across the dimensional rifts, the golden light rushes into Arizona—melting the abnormal snow, thawing the cold fog, and washing over Oak Creek Elementary!

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: Tomorrow has been unlocked.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: You stand on the glowing glass platform, panting, tears streaming down your smiling face.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: The Great Clock is humming like a purring cat, ticking in majestic, rhythmic forward harmony: tick-tock, tick-tock.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: Then, your eyes drop to the cold metal grating.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: Lying near your boots is Pip's empty houndstooth detective cap and his little tattered notebook.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: Your chest aches with a heavy, hollow pain.

segments.speaker: hero
segments.text: Pip...

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: you whisper.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: Barnaby walks up beside you, placing a heavy, gentle hand on your shoulder.

segments.speaker: pip
segments.text: The magic that erased him... it came from the clock's memory-core. But now... the clock flows forward. It restores what was lost.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: You pick up Pip’s crooked tweed hat. You hold it tight against your chest, close your eyes, and focus every ounce of your Unbound mind on your friend.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: You remember his ridiculously pompous British accent. You remember him tumbling out of the portal into the Arizona snowbank. You remember him screaming on the toboggan with his bushy tail in your face. You remember the fierce, quiet love in his yellow eyes when he pushed you to safety.

segments.speaker: hero
segments.text: Pip,

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: you whisper into the golden light.

segments.speaker: hero
segments.text: Your case isn't closed yet. Come home.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: The star-silver gear gives a bright, musical PING!

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: Right on the platform, five feet in front of you, the air begins to sparkle with cinnamon-and-sugar smoke!

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: KER-POOOOOOOF!

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: A shower of holiday confetti, glitter, and powdery snow explodes across the platform!

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: A figure drops out of mid-air, landing completely flat on his face with an undignified FLUMP!

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: Silence.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: Then, from beneath an oversized green trench coat, a muffled, pompous voice squeaked into the floorboards:

segments.speaker: pip
segments.text: Ahem! I should like to state... for the official, written record... that every single element of this operation proceeded precisely according to plan.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: Pip slowly pulled his head out of the confetti, shaking his whiskers.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: His posh British accent completely vanished.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: His yellow eyes went wide:

segments.speaker: pip
segments.text: WAIT! DID WE WIN?!

segments.speaker: hero
segments.text: PIP!

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: you scream.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: You drop to your knees and throw your arms around the little fox, hugging him so tight his brass buttons dig into your jacket!

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: Pip blinked in stunned surprise.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: Then, his little furry paws wrapped around your neck. He buried his wet black nose into your shoulder, his bushy red tail wagging so hard it slapped the grating like a drum.

segments.speaker: pip
segments.text: You did it,

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: Pip whispered, his voice trembling with tears of pure joy.

segments.speaker: pip
segments.text: I knew you could. I always knew.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: Titan walked over on his four massive paws, letting out a gentle, happy snort that blew confetti off Pip's head.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: With a soft, magical shimmer, Titan began to shrink.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: His twenty-foot battle-frame melted away until he was back to his normal, cuddly, ninety-pound American Bulldog self. He flopped onto his belly across your legs with a contented groan, his little docked nub tail thumping the floor: thump-thump-thump.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: Across the platform, the Clockmaker slowly sat up.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: His obsidian watch was cracked and lifeless. He looked out through the shattered skylight at Everfrost, glowing with golden holiday warmth, the Great Clock singing its forward song.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: For the first time in centuries, the cold, bitter sneer was gone from his face.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: Tears traced lines through the soot on his cheeks.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: It's... it's beautiful,

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: the Clockmaker whispered, his hands trembling as he watched the gears turn.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: I forgot... how beautiful tomorrow could be.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: Barnaby walked over to his old master. He didn't raise his wrench. He didn't call the guards.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: The broad-shouldered elf reached down with his calloused hand, helping the Clockmaker to his feet.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: You built a wonder, master,

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: Barnaby said softly, his braided beard brushing his chest.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: You just forgot that Christmas isn't meant to be trapped. It's meant to lead us forward.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: Barnaby patted the Clockmaker's shoulder.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: Come on, master. Let's go home. Granny has a warm plate of cookies waiting on the hearth.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: The Clockmaker bowed his head, wiping his tears with his velvet sleeve, and let his old apprentice lead him toward the lift.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: High above the clock tower, the golden temporal rift opened in the starry sky—swirling with warm desert air and the scent of Thanksgiving dinner.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: Titan stood proudly beside the basket of his peppermint balloon, his aviator goggles pushed up over his black-freckled ears. In his mouth, he held his half-empty pouch of Granny's Courage Nubbies.

segments.speaker: pip
segments.text: I will never forget you,

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: Titan rumbled softly, leaning his massive head in for one last, glorious ear scratch.

segments.speaker: pip
segments.text: You are my favorite human in the entire universe. If you ever need wood crunched... you just blow the whistle.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: Pip stepped up to the edge of the portal, his tweed houndstooth cap tilted jauntily over one ear, his long red scarf trailing in the wind.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: He pulled his tattered detective notebook from his coat, flipped to a fresh page, and tapped it with his pencil stub.

segments.speaker: pip
segments.text: Case Number One: The Never-Ending Christmas,

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: Pip announced in his finest, most aristocratic British accent.

segments.speaker: pip
segments.text: Status: Solved. By Master Detective Pip... and his legendary, Unbound partner.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: Pip looked up at you, his eyes shining with warm pride.

segments.speaker: pip
segments.text: Go on, recruit. Your friends are waiting.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: You smile, giving Pip’s furry hand a firm, final squeeze.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: You step through the swirling golden light—

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: WHOOOOOOSH!

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: You blink against the warm, brilliant afternoon sun.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: You are standing on the sidewalk in front of Oak Creek Elementary in Arizona.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: The snow is melting rapidly, trickling down the gutters in cool, singing streams. Towering green Saguaro cacti stand tall against the clear turquoise desert sky. The smell of roasted turkey, sweet pumpkin pie, and warm desert breeze fills the air.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: Hey!

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: a voice shouts.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: You turn around. Running across the school lawn toward you are your best friends, Maya and Leo!

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: Maya’s eyes are bright and full of life—the creepy, blank smile completely gone!

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: There you are!

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: Maya laughs, catching her breath.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: Where did you go? My grandma just pulled the pumpkin pie out of the oven! We've been looking everywhere for you!

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: Yeah,

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: Leo grins, tossing a football from hand to hand.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: It’s Thanksgiving! What are you doing standing by the gym?

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: You look down at your coat pocket.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: Tucked safely inside your pocket is Pip's tattered detective pencil stub, and a single, star-shaped holiday cookie wrapped in a napkin from Granny's kitchen.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: You smile—a real, warm, confident smile.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: For your whole life, you wondered why your mind worked differently. You wondered why you saw patterns others missed, and why you couldn't always explain how you knew the truth.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: Now, you know.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: You aren't broken. You aren't strange.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: You are the Unbound.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: And you are ready for tomorrow.
